instruction.text: Spell the name of the sacred Maya text.

finish.text: The Popol Vuh is a book of Maya myths and history.
finish.sound: The Popple Voo is a book of Maya myths and history.

atoms.b: The book documents the creation of humans, myths of the ((++gods frogs)) and the history of the K'iche' people and their kings.
atoms.sound: ssml: The book documents the creation of humans, myths of the gods and the history of the <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='kiːˈtʃeɪ'>K'iche'</phoneme> people and their kings.

atoms.b: These stories had been told for generations, but were written down for the very first time in the 1500s in the language of ((++K'iche' German)).
atoms.sound: ssml: These stories had been told for generations, but were written down for the very first time in the 1500s in the language of <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='kiːˈtʃeɪ'>K'iche'</phoneme>.

finish.text: It is important to remember that the Popol Vuh was written long after the time it describes and only contains the views of one group of the Maya people.
finish.sound: It is important to remember that the Popple Voo was written long after the time it describes and only contains the views of one group of the Maya people.

instruction.text: Read the first part of the creation story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The Popol Vuh begins with the Maya gods, who live in the sea and the sky. The gods were unhappy that there was no one to praise them, so they decided to create humans.
atoms.sound: The Popple Voo begins with the Maya gods, who live in the sea and the sky. The gods were unhappy that there was no one to praise them, so they decided to create humans.

atoms.text: First, the gods tried to make humans out of mud, but they kept falling apart.
Then, the gods tried to make humans out of wood, but they couldn’t praise the gods because they had no emotions.
Finally, they decided to make humans out of maize.

atoms.a: Where do the Maya gods live?
atoms.sound: ssml: where do the maya gods livv?

atoms.a: What did the gods want humans to do?
What were the humans first made out of?

instruction.text: Drag the cloud to cover his eyes.

feedback.finish: The humans the gods created were almost perfect, but they were too clever. The gods decided to put mist over their eyes so they could not understand the world in the same way as the gods.

instruction.text: Put the stages of human creation in order. Start with the first material used at the top.
Select the three foods that are made from maize.

feedback.finish: Maize is very important in Maya culture because of its use in the creation story. There are still ceremonies and festivals held every year to show gratitude for their corn harvest.
